name: Yiyue Luo
title: Assistant Professor
fitReason: Strong recent-AP tactile/embodied-AI option with a direct external-master-compatible inquiry form. Computational tactile learning and multimodal sensing align with CS research, alongside substantial fabrication and hardware work.

physicalEvidence.summary: LocoTouch trains a PPO teacher and distills a tactile convnet-GRU policy with behavior cloning/DAgger, then executes learned joint-position control on a real Unitree Go1 transporting unsecured objects. This is shared CMU/UW/Google apparatus, not verified UW-local access. Separately, the 2026 CPR glove uses personalized LDA force/pose classification to drive actual vibrotactile cues in an eight-person manikin pilot; it does not autonomously perform CPR.

shortVisit.status: inquiry-only · external Masters; summer and six-month examples, no stated minimum
shortVisit.summary: The live PI-linked interest form accepts non-UW affiliation and Masters designation. Its free-text desired-position field explicitly gives summer internship and six-month visiting-student examples. The homepage separately invites visitors/interns. This is a real inquiry route, with Summer 2027 availability, exact duration, remote participation and funding still unknown.

scoreReasons.fit: Direct robot tactile learning plus current embodied wearable/HRI AI methods and a verified independent UW lab.
scoreReasons.physical: Full real learned Go1 methods verified, conservatively capped at 20 for collaborative apparatus. Current learned haptic pilot is separately identified and limited.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: Explicit live non-UW master form and summer-intern example, but no specified compatible duration or 2027 offer.
scoreReasons.freshness: Full March 2026 technical study and August 2026 paper establish current research beyond appointment publicity.

sources.label: arxiv.org / source 8
sources.summary: Full March 2026 current UW/GIST study: personalized LDA classifies tactile force/pose, predictions drive physical vibrotactile feedback in an eight-person CPR-manikin pilot. Compression rate uses deterministic peak intervals; computation is offboard. It is preliminary training-interface evidence, not clinical efficacy or autonomous chest-compression robotics. Headline latency/accuracy claims are not reused because full methods distinguish sensor and model timing and within-person calibration.

unknowns: Six months is an example in an open-ended form, not a stated minimum or preference. Summer 2027 capacity and an approximately eight-week project are unconfirmed.
No paid placement, remote arrangement or guaranteed hardware access is stated. The form requires a proposed project and CV and may require a Google sign-in for upload.

LocoTouch hardware is collaborative; the 2026 glove is a preliminary manikin-training interface with offboard inference and user-specific calibration. Do not present it as validated clinical assistance or autonomous CPR.

UW VISIT is the relevant institutional research-visitor route for enrolled outside graduate students; supervisor, department and home-institution approval are still needed. Confirm funding documentation, current fees and processing lead time with the office.
Public robot research does not confirm current equipment access, a summer 2027 offer or host availability.
